headline: HOU @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is HOU 4.40 at CHC 3.84, with a projected total of 8.24. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward HOU: HOU moved +1.20 runs while CHC moved -0.95, changing the projected margin by +2.15 runs. NRFI probability dropped -9.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Kai-Wei Teng has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.0 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alex Bregman, Isaac Paredes, Nico Hoerner, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Ian Happ, Zach Cole because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
